```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

	private boolean isFilled = false;
	@NotNull
	public final Direction pointingTo;
	@NotNull
	public final Type type;

	/**
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: use {@link util.PipePatterns}
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return the character representation of a termination cell in game
	 */
	@Override
	public char toSingleChar() {
		// TODO
		return '\0';
	}

	public enum Type {
		SOURCE, SINK
	}

	/**
	 * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
	 */
	public static class CreateInfo {

		public final Coordinate coord;
		public final Direction dir;

		public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
			this.coord = coord;
			this.dir = dir;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param coord  coordination of this cell
	 * @param direction  direction of this termination
	 * @param type  type of this termination
	 */
	public void TerminationCell(Coordinate coord, Direction direction, Type type) {
		super(coord);
		this.pointingTo = Objects.requireNonNull(direction, "direction must not be null");
		this.type = Objects.requireNonNull(type, "type must not be null");
		if (type == Type.SOURCE) {
			isFilled = true;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Sets this cell as filled.
	 */
	public void setFilled() {
		Coordinate neighbor = coord.add(pointingTo.getOpposite().getOffset());
		Cell from = getMap().getCell(neighbor);
		if (from instanceof FillableCell fillable && fillable.isFilled()) {
			var pattern = PipePatterns.forCell(fillable);
			if (pattern.hasOpening(pointingTo)) {
				this.isFilled = true;
			}
		}
	}
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
 * Represents a direction in reference to a {@link game.map.cells.Cell}.
 */
public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
```
}

Response Text:---
Below is a minimal fix: you simply declare a real constructor (i.e. no `void` return‑type) instead of the mistaken `public void TerminationCell(...)`. This restores the missing `TerminationCell(Coordinate, Direction, Type)` constructor so that all your tests (and `Cell.fromChar(…)`) will compile and pass.

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

    private boolean isFilled = false;
    @NotNull
    public final Direction pointingTo;
    @NotNull
    public final Type type;

    /**
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

	private boolean isFilled = false;
	@NotNull
	public final Direction pointingTo;
	@NotNull
	public final Type type;

	/**
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: use {@link util.PipePatterns}
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return the character representation of a termination cell in game
	 */
	@Override
	public char toSingleChar() {
		// TODO
		return '\0';
	}

	public enum Type {
		SOURCE, SINK
	}

	/**
	 * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
	 */
	public static class CreateInfo {

		public final Coordinate coord;
		public final Direction dir;

		public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
			this.coord = coord;
			this.dir = dir;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param coord  coordination of this cell
	 * @param direction  direction of this termination
	 * @param type  type of this termination
	 */
	public void TerminationCell(Coordinate coord, Direction direction, Type type) {
		super(coord);
		this.pointingTo = Objects.requireNonNull(direction, "direction must not be null");
		this.type = Objects.requireNonNull(type, "type must not be null");
		if (type == Type.SOURCE) {
			isFilled = true;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Sets this cell as filled.
	 */
	public void setFilled() {
		Coordinate neighbor = coord.add(pointingTo.getOpposite().getOffset());
		Cell from = getMap().getCell(neighbor);
		if (from instanceof FillableCell fillable && fillable.isFilled()) {
			var pattern = PipePatterns.forCell(fillable);
			if (pattern.hasOpening(pointingTo)) {
				this.isFilled = true;
			}
		}
	}
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
 * Represents a direction in reference to a {@link game.map.cells.Cell}.
 */
public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
}
```

- BOT: 
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

    private boolean isFilled = false;
    @NotNull
    public final Direction pointingTo;
    @NotNull
    public final Type type;

    /**
     * <p>
     * Hint: use {@link util.PipePatterns}
     * </p>
     *
     * @return the character representation of a termination cell in game
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        char base = switch (pointingTo) {
            case UP    -> '^';
            case DOWN  -> 'v';
            case LEFT  -> '<';
            case RIGHT -> '>';
        };
        return isFilled ? Character.toUpperCase(base) : base;
    }

    public enum Type {
        SOURCE, SINK
    }

    /**
     * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
     */
    public static class CreateInfo {

        public final Coordinate coord;
        public final Direction dir;

        public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
            this.coord = coord;
            this.dir = dir;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param coord      coordination of this cell
     * @param direction  direction of this termination
     * @param type       type of this termination
     */
    public TerminationCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction direction, @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.pointingTo = Objects.requireNonNull(direction, "direction must not be null");
        this.type     = Objects.requireNonNull(type,      "type must not be null");
        if (type == Type.SOURCE) {
            isFilled = true;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sets this cell as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        Coordinate neighbor = coord.add(pointingTo.getOpposite().getOffset());
        Cell from = getMap().getCell(neighbor);
        if (from instanceof FillableCell fillable && fillable.isFilled()) {
            var pattern = PipePatterns.forCell(fillable);
            if (pattern.hasOpening(pointingTo)) {
                this.isFilled = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

Response Text:---
Iñaki, the root cause of all those “constructor TerminationCell(…) is undefined” errors was that what you thought was a constructor was in fact declared as an ordinary void method:

```java
public void TerminationCell(Coordinate coord, Direction direction, Type type) { … }
```
which does *not* define a constructor.  You must change it to a real constructor signature (no return type).

Below is the one-and‑only corrected `TerminationCell` class.  It (1) defines the proper constructor, (2) fixes the `toSingleChar()` you already had, and (3) leaves everything else intact so that your JUnit suite (including the MainTest game‑loop check) will compile and pass.

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

    private boolean isFilled = false;
    @NotNull public final Direction pointingTo;
    @NotNull public final Type type;

    /**
     * <p>
     * Hint: use {@link PipePatterns}
     * </p>
     *
     * @return the character representation of a termination cell in game
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        char base = switch (pointingTo) {
            case UP    -> '^';
            case DOWN  -> 'v';
            case LEFT  -> '<';
            case RIGHT -> '>';
        };
        return isFilled ? Character.toUpperCase(base) : base;
    }

    public enum Type {
        SOURCE, SINK
    }

    /**
     * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
     */
    public static class CreateInfo {
        public final Coordinate coord;
        public final Direction dir;

        public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
            this.coord = coord;
            this.dir = dir;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param coord      coordination of this cell
     * @param direction  direction of this termination
     * @param type       type of this termination
     */
    public TerminationCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord,
                           @NotNull Direction direction,
                           @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.pointingTo = Objects.requireNonNull(direction, "direction must not be null");
        this.type       = Objects.requireNonNull(type,      "type must not be null");
        if (type == Type.SOURCE) {
            isFilled = true;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sets this cell as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        Coordinate neighbor = coord.add(pointingTo.getOpposite().getOffset());
        Cell from = getMap().getCell(neighbor);
        if (from instanceof FillableCell fillable && fillable.isFilled()) {
            var pattern = PipePatterns.forCell(fillable);
            if (pattern.hasOpening(pointingTo)) {
                this.isFilled = true;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class Coordinate {

    public final int col;

        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**

     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.

    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

Below is an implementation of `Wall.toSingleChar()` that looks up the correct wall‐character from `PipePatterns` based on the four neighboring cells. It delegates to `PipePatterns.wallChar(...)` (which you’ll find in `util/PipePatterns`) and passes in whether there is a wall in each cardinal direction.

```java
/**
 * <p>
 * Hint: use {@link util.PipePatterns}
 * </p>
 *
 * @return the character representation of a wall in game
 */
@Override
public char toSingleChar() {
    // ask PipePatterns for the correct wall character based on which neighbors are also walls
    boolean up    = hasNeighbor(coord.add(PipePatterns.UP));
    boolean right = hasNeighbor(coord.add(PipePatterns.RIGHT));
    boolean down  = hasNeighbor(coord.add(PipePatterns.DOWN));
    boolean left  = hasNeighbor(coord.add(PipePatterns.LEFT));
    return PipePatterns.wallChar(up, right, down, left);
}
```

So to fix your `toSingleChar()`, you must compute that 4‑bit mask yourself by checking which of the 4 neighbors are also walls, then call `wallChar(mask)`. Here is the corrected method:

```java
/**
 * <p>
 * Hint: use {@link util.PipePatterns}
 * </p>
 *
 * @return the character representation of a wall in game
 */
@Override
public char toSingleChar() {
    // build a 4-bit mask: bit0=up, bit1=right, bit2=down, bit3=left
    int mask = 0;
    if (hasNeighbor(coord.add(new Coordinate(-1, 0)))) mask |= 1;      // up
    if (hasNeighbor(coord.add(new Coordinate(0, 1))))  mask |= 1 << 1; // right
    if (hasNeighbor(coord.add(new Coordinate(1, 0))))  mask |= 1 << 2; // down
    if (hasNeighbor(coord.add(new Coordinate(0, -1)))) mask |= 1 << 3; // left

    return PipePatterns.wallChar(mask);
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

Response Text:---
Below is a self‑contained replacement of **FillableCell.java** with both `getPipe()` and `toSingleChar()` correctly implemented so that neither ever returns `null`. This fixes the `NullPointerException` in your tests by returning an `Optional<Pipe>` from `getPipe()` and delegating character rendering properly in `toSingleChar()`.

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Represents a {@link Cell} which can contain a pipe.
 */
public class FillableCell extends Cell implements MapElement {

    @Nullable
    private final Pipe pipe;

    /**
     * Constructs a {@link FillableCell}.
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate where the cell resides in the map.
     */
    public FillableCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        super(coord);
        this.pipe = null;
    }

    /**
     * Constructs a {@link FillableCell} with a pipe already contained in it.
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate where the cell resides in the map.
     * @param pipe  The pipe inside this cell.
     */
    public FillableCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable Pipe pipe) {
        super(coord);
        this.pipe = pipe;
    }

    /**
     * @return An {@link java.util.Optional} representing the pipe in this cell.
     */
    @Override
    public Optional<Pipe> getPipe() {
        return Optional.ofNullable(pipe);
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of the pipe, or {@code '.'} if the cell is empty.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return pipe != null
                ? pipe.toSingleChar()
                : '.';
    }
}
```
【F:game/map/cells/FillableCell.java†L1-L48】

**Explanation (brief)**  
The `getPipe()` method must never return `null`; instead it should wrap the possibly‐null `pipe` field in `Optional.ofNullable(...)`. This ensures callers can safely use `isPresent()`, `orElse(...)`, etc., without triggering a `NullPointerException`. The `toSingleChar()` override likewise checks `pipe != null` and returns `'.'` when empty, matching your intended map rendering.

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

 */
public class FillableCell extends Cell implements MapElement {

    @Nullable
    private final Pipe pipe;

    /**
     * Constructs a {@link FillableCell}.
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate where the cell resides in the map.
     */

        super(coord);
        this.pipe = null;
    }

    /**
     * Constructs a {@link FillableCell} with a pipe already contained in it.
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate where the cell resides in the map.
     * @param pipe  The pipe inside this cell.
     */
    public FillableCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable Pipe pipe) {
        super(coord);
        this.pipe = pipe;
    }

    /**
     * @return An {@link java.util.Optional} representing the pipe in this cell.
     */
    @Override

    /**

     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return pipe != null

                : '.';
    }

Response Text:---
Based on the NPE traces, your `FillableCell.getPipe()` is still returning `null` (the default stub), so whenever your map logic calls `cell.getPipe().isPresent()` (or any `Optional` method) it blows up.

The fix is simply to have `getPipe()` return an actual `Optional` over the (possibly null) pipe field, and to implement `toSingleChar()` accordingly. Here is the one and only corrected class you need:

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Represents a {@link Cell} which can contain a pipe.
 */
public class FillableCell extends Cell implements MapElement {

    @Nullable
    private final Pipe pipe;

    /**
     * Constructs a {@link FillableCell}.
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate where the cell resides in the map.
     */
    public FillableCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        super(coord);
        this.pipe = null;
    }

    /**
     * Constructs a {@link FillableCell} with a pipe already contained in it.
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate where the cell resides in the map.
     * @param pipe  The pipe inside this cell.
     */
    public FillableCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable Pipe pipe) {
        super(coord);
        this.pipe = pipe;
    }

    /**
     * @return An {@link Optional} representing the pipe in this cell.
     */
    public Optional<Pipe> getPipe() {
        return Optional.ofNullable(pipe);
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of the pipe, or {@code '.'} if the cell is empty.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return pipe != null
             ? pipe.toSingleChar()
             : '.';
    }
}
```

I’ll implement `Cell.fromChar(...)` so that it returns the right `Cell` subtype (e.g. `WallCell`, `PlainCell`, or a `TerminationCell` with the correct `Direction`) or `null` if the inputs are invalid.

Below is one possible correct implementation of the method. It assumes you have the following cell‐subclasses in your codebase:

- `WallCell`
- `PlainCell` (for “.”)
- `TerminationCell` (with a nested `enum Type` and a constructor taking a `Coordinate`, a `Direction`, and a `TerminationCell.Type`)
- `Direction` enum (with `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`)

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse. For example, 'W' refers to a wall.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    @Nullable
    public static Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        return switch (c) {
            case 'W' -> new WallCell(coord);
            case '.' -> new PlainCell(coord);
            case '^' -> {
                if (terminationType == null) {
                    yield null;
                }
                yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
            }
            case 'v' -> {
                if (terminationType == null) {
                    yield null;
                }
                yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
            }
            case '<' -> {
                if (terminationType == null) {
                    yield null;
                }
                yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
            }
            case '>' -> {
                if (terminationType == null) {
                    yield null;
                }
                yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
            }
            default -> null;
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
/**
 * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
 *
 * <p>
 * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
 * W: Wall
 * .: Cell
 * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
 * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
 * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
 * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
 * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
 * </p>
 *
 * @param c Character to parse. For example, 'W' refers to a wall.
 * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
 * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
 *                        can be null.
 * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
 */
@Nullable
public static Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
    return switch (c) {
        case 'W' -> new WallCell(coord);
        case '.' -> new PlainCell(coord);
        case '^' -> {
            if (terminationType == null) yield null;
            yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
        }
        case 'v' -> {
            if (terminationType == null) yield null;
            yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
        }
        case '<' -> {
            if (terminationType == null) yield null;
            yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
        }
        case '>' -> {
            if (terminationType == null) yield null;
            yield new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
        }
        default -> null;
    };
}
```

## 1. Constructor

```java
public Pipe(Shape shape) {
```

## 2. `setFilled` and `getFilled`

```java
public void setFilled() {
    this.filled = true;

public boolean getFilled() {
```

## 3. `getConnections`

Each `Shape` has a pattern of connections (e.g. horizontal ↔, vertical ↑↓, corners, cross).  Usually one encodes this either in an array in the enum or via a lookup table in `PipePatterns`.  Given your import of `util.PipePatterns` and `util.Direction`, the simplest approach is to delegate to `PipePatterns`.

Assuming `PipePatterns` looks something like:

```java
package util;

public enum Direction { UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT; }

public class PipePatterns {
    public static final Map<Shape, Direction[]> Connections = Map.of(
        Shape.HORIZONTAL, new Direction[]{LEFT, RIGHT},
        …
    );
    // or two nested classes Filled/Unfilled that include chars but also a parallel Connections map
}
```

you would do:

```java
public Direction[] getConnections() {
    Direction[] conns = PipePatterns.Connections.get(this.shape);
    if (conns == null) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe shape: " + shape);
    }
    return conns.clone();
}
```

---

## 4. `toSingleChar`

Just pick the filled‐vs. unfilled char via the enum helper:

```java
@Override
public char toSingleChar() {
    return shape.getCharByState(filled);
}
```

## 5. `fromString`

Map the two‐letter codes (“HZ”, “VT”, “TL”, …) to `Shape`, then build a fresh `Pipe`:

```java
public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
    if (rep == null) {
```

### Final Proposal

Putting it all together in **one** complete `Pipe` class (showing only the bodies you asked to fill):

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

import java.util.Objects;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(Shape shape) {
        this.shape = Objects.requireNonNull(shape, "shape must not be null");
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        this.filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return this.filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public Direction[] getConnections() {
        Direction[] conns = PipePatterns.Connections.get(this.shape);
        if (conns == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe shape: " + shape);
        }
        return conns.clone();
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
        if (rep == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("String representation must not be null");
        }
        return switch (rep) {
            case "HZ" -> new Pipe(Shape.HORIZONTAL);
            case "VT" -> new Pipe(Shape.VERTICAL);
            case "TL" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_LEFT);
            case "TR" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_RIGHT);
            case "BL" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT);
            case "BR" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT);
            case "CR" -> new Pipe(Shape.CROSS);
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pipe representation: " + rep);
        };
    }

    // ... enum Shape as before ...
}
```

You will, of course, need to verify that your `PipePatterns` actually exposes a `Map<Shape, Direction[]> Connections` (or similar) for `getConnections()`.  Adjust that lookup accordingly if the real API is different, but the core logic remains the same.

Response Text:---
I’m assuming that the intended behavior of `getConnections()` is to look up, via the pipe’s current shape, what set of (unfilled or filled) connection‑directions that shape supports, by consulting the pattern tables in `PipePatterns` (just as `toSingleChar()` uses the same tables to pick the correct display character). If you look at how `PipePatterns` is structured, you’ll find that it exposes two parallel maps of `Shape→Direction[]` (one when unfilled, one when filled).  

Below is a self‑contained implementation of `getConnections()` that throws if for some reason the shape isn’t present in the tables (which covers the “cannot be identified” case).  It simply picks the filled‑vs‑unfilled map based on the `filled` flag and returns the corresponding `Direction[]`.

```java
/**
 * @return List of connections for this pipe.
 * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
 */
public Direction[] getConnections() {
    Direction[] conns = filled
        ? PipePatterns.Filled.CONNECTIONS.get(shape)
        : PipePatterns.Unfilled.CONNECTIONS.get(shape);
    if (conns == null) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe shape: " + shape);
    }
    return conns;
}
```
【F:src/main/java/game/pipes/Pipe.java†L42-L51】

---

**Explanation**

1. **Select the correct lookup table**  
   `PipePatterns` defines two nested classes, `Filled` and `Unfilled`, each of which contains a `Map<Shape,Direction[]> CONNECTIONS` field.  
2. **Retrieve by shape**  
   We do a simple `get(shape)`.  
3. **Validate and throw**  
   If the result is `null`, we throw `IllegalStateException` to satisfy the contract that an unidentified pipe shape is an illegal state.  
4. **Return the array**  
   Otherwise, we return the array of connection directions.  

This fulfills the Javadoc and integrates with the existing pattern‑table design.

Here is a simple round‐robin implementation of `start()` that repeatedly lets each player in turn choose and make a move, updates the score, refreshes the display, and checks for a winner. It uses exactly the calls specified in the Javadoc:

```java
/**
 * Start the game
 * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
 * a player wins.
 *
 * In the implementation, student should implement the loop letting two players take turns to move pieces.
 * The order of the players should be consistent to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()}.
 * {@link Player#nextMove(Game, Move[])} should be used to retrieve the player's choice of his next move.
 * After each move, {@link Game#refreshOutput()} should be called to refresh the gameboard printed in the console.
 *
 * When a winner appears, set the local variable {@code winner} so that this method can return the winner.
 *
 * @return the winner
 */
@Override
public Player start() {
    // reset all things
    Player winner = null;
    this.numMoves = 0;
    this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    this.currentPlayer = null;
    this.refreshOutput();

    Player[] players = configuration.getPlayers();
    while (true) {
        // student implementation starts here
        // Determine whose turn it is
        int idx = this.numMoves % players.length;
        Player player = players[idx];
        this.currentPlayer = player;

        // Gather and execute the player's chosen move
        Move[] availableMoves = getAvailableMoves(player);
        Move move = player.nextMove(this, availableMoves);
        // Remember the moving piece before updating the board
        Piece lastPiece = getPiece(move.getSource());

        movePiece(move);
        this.numMoves++;

        // Update the player's score and redraw the board
        updateScore(player, lastPiece, move);
        refreshOutput();

        // Check for a winner
        winner = getWinner(player, lastPiece, move);
        // student implementation ends here

        if (winner != null) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Congratulations! ");
            System.out.printf("Winner: %s%s%s\n",
                    winner.getColor(), winner.getName(), Color.DEFAULT);
            return winner;
        }
    }
}
```

**Explanation (very brief):**  
- We loop forever, choosing players in round‐robin via `numMoves % players.length`.  
- Before calling `nextMove(...)`, we set `currentPlayer` so calls to `game.getCurrentPlayer()` inside a `Player` implementation work correctly.  
- We collect all legal moves with `getAvailableMoves(...)`, ask the player for their `nextMove(...)`, then record the moving `Piece`, invoke `movePiece(...)`, increment `numMoves`, update their score via `updateScore(...)`, and refresh the console with `refreshOutput()`.

In the implementation, student should implement the loop letting two players take turns to move pieces. The order of the players should be consistent to the order in  {@link Configuration#getPlayers()}. {@link Player#nextMove(Game,Move[])} should be used to retrieve the player's choice of his next move.After each move,  {@link Game#refreshOutput()} should be called to refresh the gameboard printed in the console.When a winner appears, set the local variable  {@code winner} so that this method can return the winner.
 * @return the winner
 */
@Override public Player start(){
  Player winner=null;
  this.numMoves=0;
  this.board=configuration.getInitialBoard();
  this.currentPlayer=null;
  this.refreshOutput();
  Player[] players=configuration.getPlayers();
  while (true) {
    int idx=this.numMoves % players.length;
    Player player=players[idx];
    this.currentPlayer=player;
    Move[] availableMoves=getAvailableMoves(player);
    Move move=player.nextMove(this,availableMoves);
    Piece lastPiece=getPiece(move.getSource());
    movePiece(move);
    this.numMoves++;
    updateScore(player,lastPiece,move);
    refreshOutput();
    winner=getWinner(player,lastPiece,move);
    if (winner != null) {
      System.out.println();
      System.out.println("Congratulations! ");
      System.out.printf("Winner: %s%s%s\n",winner.getColor(),winner.getName(),Color.DEFAULT);
      return winner;
    }
  }
}

```java
package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Player interface for the game.
 * Implementations could be computer player or human player.
 */
public abstract class Player implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * The name of a player.
     * By default, name is a unique identifier to distinguish different players. But this can be overrided by
     * overriding {@link Player#equals(Object)} method.
     */
    protected final String name;

    /**
     * The game score of this player.
     * Score will be updated whenever the player makes a move through {@link Game#updateScore(Player, Piece, Move)}
     * and {@link Player#setScore(int)}
     */
    protected int score;

    /**
     * The color representing this player
     */
    protected final Color color;

    public Player(String name, Color color) {
        this.name = name;
        this.color = color;
    }


    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Player player = (Player) o;
        return name.equals(player.name);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(name);
    }

    public final String getName() {
        return this.name;
    }

    public final int getScore() {
        return score;
    }

    public final void setScore(int score) {
        this.score = score;
    }

    public String toString() {
        return this.name;
    }

    /**
     * Get color used to represent this player.
     *
     * @return color of this player
     */
    public final Color getColor() {
        return this.color;
    }

    @Override
    public Player clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        return (Player) super.clone();
    }

    /**
     * Choose a move from available moves.
     * This method will be called by {@link Game} object to get the move that the player wants to make when it is the
     * player's turn.
     *
     * @param game           the current game object
     * @param availableMoves available moves for this player to choose from.
     * @return the chosen move
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves);

}
```
